geometry.window_status: Retained Phase 3D window schedule; doors included in effective opaque area, actual door/glazing U values held.

thermal.U_status: 0.7 retained predecessor; 1.5 planning target; 2.5 degraded-envelope sensitivity. None is demonstrated whole-body U.
thermal.weather_and_ventilation_status: Retained engineering sensitivities, not official climate design data or adopted ventilation rate; solar separated from evening duty.
thermal.duct_status: Geometric gross duct allocation; insulation/liners/grilles and pressure loss reduce usable area. Not an airflow acceptance.
thermal.occupancy_status: Regular: 32 passengers plus one thermal person allowance. Accessible: 13 passengers plus one thermal person allowance. Whole consist: 113 thermal occupants. These allowances are not a staffing prescription.
thermal.internal_heat_status: The 200 W internal-equipment thermal allocation is separate from the 1080 W electrical auxiliary schedule. Reconcile actual fan, lighting and control heat entering the cabin and underfloor charger/conversion losses before selection.

brake_DC.status: All device currents/duties are explicit allocations, not manufacturer ratings. Stored springs apply brakes; battery reserve is not emergency application energy.

lighting_DC.status: Separate local reserve; duration and illuminance require accepted evacuation/lighting design.

electrical_comparisons.auxiliary_transformer_status: Efficiency allowance only; no transformer size or topology selected.
electrical_comparisons.maintenance_status: Operationally isolated during passenger running; not diversified without an enforced interlock/procedure.

modular_comparison.gap_status: Analyst one-dimensional service/air-spacing comparison only, not asserted OEM clearance or accepted arrangement; no roof holes authorized.

generic_starting.status: Unknown rail-package starting demand sensitivity. Actual waveform, duration, drive behavior and voltage dip limits are held.

consist.status: Whole-consist hotel supply screen only; locomotive traction and other locomotive auxiliaries excluded.

warmup.status: Held actual mass/material thermal response and operating preheat procedure. Do not size generator from occupied heat alone; warm-up total remains blank until inputs are supplied.
